svg.title: XVII. The Star: direnv.nvim
svg.desc: XVII. The Star, reversed. Neovim Plugins. Neovim companion for Direnv. Artwork from scanned Gustave Doré Inferno engravings, first published in 1861.

g.desc: Gustave Doré, Inferno (1861), I, who now bid thee on this errand forth, am Beatrice. https://archive.org/details/dantesinferno00dantuoft; scan leaf 54. Public domain: nineteenth-century engravings; Doré died in 1883. The digitizing collection records NOT_IN_COPYRIGHT.
